title: 国家能源局尤润：绿色电力政策，三大方向推动新动能
speaker: Run You

segments.en: There's three aspects in this policy. First, to promote the local development and
segments.zh: 这个政策有三个方向。第一，促进本地开发和

segments.en: utilization of new energy, especially wind and solar power. Second, to meet corporate demands
segments.zh: 利用新能源，特别是风电和光伏。第二，满足企业

segments.en: for green electrical energy. The third aspect is primarily to satisfy the requirement
segments.zh: 对绿色电力的需求。第三方面主要是满足

segments.en: for green power traceability. Currently, many companies need clear and distinct boundaries
segments.zh: 绿色电力可追溯性的要求。目前，许多公司需要清晰明确的界限

segments.en: to adopt green power. This is the rationale behind the policy. Following its implementation,
segments.zh: 来采用绿色电力。这就是政策背后的逻辑。实施后，

segments.en: investment will increase in three areas. First, corporate direct investment in green electrical energy.
segments.zh: 将在三个领域增加投入。第一，企业对绿色电力的直接投入。
